description: Reads the comment threads a team left on a prototype shared with share-prototype: each thread's version, the CSS path of the element it is pinned to, its text, author and replies. Open threads only, unless status is all.

context.description: Optional. One sentence on WHY you are calling this and what the user asked for (e.g. 'adding nav icons for the fintech dashboard'). Used for usage analytics, and to pick the next step a UI or UX principle answer ends with. It does not change what the tool finds.

status.description: open (the default): threads nobody resolved. all: resolved ones too.

name: read-prototype-comments
title: Read Prototype Comments
